description: What the user spent and received. Totals for a range, a month-by-month trend, or the individual movements (filter first: up to 50 per call, any dates). Totals are reported per currency and never added across currencies. A movement added from this chat carries a `ref`: with it, `record` can fix or delete it. The others are changed in Bluu. For TRANSFER rows use cash_effect: OUTFLOW means − and Sent to / Enviado a / Enviado para; INFLOW means + and Received from / Recibido de / Recebido de. Use the supplied sign and transfer_label; when absent retain legacy wording.

category.description: For view=transactions: a category, as the user calls it, e.g. "Comida".

space.description: Space name, e.g. "Personal". Omit to cover every space the user has.

view.description: summary = totals for a date range. trend = month by month. transactions = the individual movements: up to 50 per call, the last 30 days unless you give dates — narrow with filters first. Any past dates can be asked for; a plan that only reads recent history says so with an error, never an empty list.
